item.title: Parking Bays Blocked with Building Materials, 11th September
item.description:
There is ongoing building going on at 6 Plymouth Road. The builders routinely block a parking bay (including now over a weekend) with building materials in order to permanently reserve a free parking bay without a parking permit. This has been going on for months with some reports as early as June. As a result there is usually not enough parking for actual residents of the street who have legitimately paid for a parking permit.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Plymouth Road, Plaistow, Greater London

item.title: Full rubbish bins and wasp nest, 11th September
item.description:
There are two full litter bins, one on the corner of Kelsey Way and the other next to it on Manor Way. They are attracting wasps that seem to be coming from the bushes or leaves underneath the bushes, next to the bin on Manor Way. 12 students from the nearby secondary school have been stung since Monday this week. Please empty these bins and deal with the wasps as it has been very distressing for the students each morning.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kelsey Way, Beckenham, Greater London
